turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty busy, but good.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My teacher keeps telling me to practise with a metronome. I find it so boring.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fair, it's not thrilling. But it's one of the fastest ways to clean up your playing.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My spaniel rolled in something unspeakable and he smells like a bin.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh no. Are you going to wrestle him into the bath yourself, or book him in at a groomer?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you go quiet till I say I'm back? Got to sort something with my sister.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay, sure.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, what were you saying?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Just that the bus was late again.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Jordan, could you hold the bowl still? I'm folding the egg whites and it keeps spinning.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Like this? Both hands?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, perfect. Don't tilt it.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Why are you going so slowly? Just stir it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: If I stir it, all the air goes and the sponge comes out like a rubber mat.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Huh. So that's what happened to mine last Easter.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Probably. Okay, nearly there. Can you pass me the tin after?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: The round one or the square one?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The round one, it's already lined.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, finished. I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. Still deciding about that bin smell. DIY wash, or professional?
